# A window's menu looping over a list const, beside a stack, picked in a test
# on html, whose test page is the stack's home document. The const is a shared
# asset there, and a spread of it went unlinked, so the page raised as it
# loaded; with it linked, a pick wrote the about page's text, which the home
# document holds no element for. testdata/nav_stack_html_menu_const.txtar
# pins both in the generated pages.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import "sngl:test"

const sizes = ["Small", "Medium", "Large"]

component app root {
    var size = "Medium"
    var picks = 0

    func choose(s string) {
        size = s
        picks += 1
    }

    ui.window #main(title="Sizes") {
        component menu {
            ui.menuItem(label="Size") {
                ui.menuItem(label="Default", checked=size == "Medium", @select { size = "Medium" })
                for var s = sizes {
                    ui.menuItem(label=s, checked=s == size, @select { choose(s) })
                }
            }
        }
        nav.stack #pages {
            nav.page #home(href="/", title="Home") {
                ui.text(value="home")
            }
            nav.page #about(href="/about", title="About") {
                ui.text(value="about {size}")
            }
        }
    }
}

app()

func testALoopedEntryIsPicked(t test.Test, c app) {
    c.main.menu[0].select()
    c.main.menu[0].children[3].select()
    t.assert(c.size == "Large" && c.picks == 1)
    t.assert(c.main.menu[0].children[3].checked)
}

func testTheEntryBeforeTheLoopIsPicked(t test.Test, c app) {
    c.main.menu[0].select()
    c.main.menu[0].children[1].select()
    c.main.menu[0].children[0].select()
    t.assert(c.size == "Medium" && c.main.menu[0].children[0].checked)
}
